ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with roughly 40% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the mid-lateral lobes and 60% low-intensity black pixels across the central, peduncle, and trailing edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions occupy the central-to-distal portions of both lobes. The left lobe white area is bounded by a jagged black border and contains several parallel dark linear features. The right lobe white area is more continuous but tapers toward a heavily textured and dark-pigmented distal tip. Central peduncle and trailing edges consist of contiguous low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary. Significant notches (valleys) of 10-20 pixel depth are visible at multiple points, particularly on the outer third of both lobes, creating a jagged, non-linear profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curve toward the tips, while the trailing edges demonstrate a complex sweep that is concave near the median notch and becomes irregularly convex toward the distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (white on black) are present on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment points or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 4-5 parallel dark linear tracks (rake marks) are visible within the white pigmentation of the left lobe. Multiple single-line white scratches are also detected in the central dark-pigmented region near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake mark scars on the upper left lobe; heavy irregular texture and loss of smooth contour at the distal right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct Y-shaped high-contrast white scar is visible in the lower central dark region just above the median notch.
